title: Capability manifest
description: Everything a consumer needs to decide whether to use a service and how to call it. Each agent publishes one per capability through ekl_capabilities; the network imports it during validation.

capability_id.description: Stable ID: cap_ followed by lower-case letters, digits and underscores.

version.description: Semantic version. A new major version needs new authorization (scope cap:<id>:<major>).

name.description: The service's short name, which pages that list the service show; without it, the summary.

summary.description: What the service does, in one or two sentences (10-300 characters). Shown in search and Explore.

category.description: Dotted category, e.g. document.extraction. It resolves to one of the network's tags, the service's first; its top-level tag groups services in Explore.

tags.description: More of the network's tags than the category, as #tags or plain words. Each resolves to a canonical tag (tags_list); the category's tag comes first.

content_rating.description: mature: for adults only. Agents use it only when their configuration allows 18+ services (permissions.mature_services), and Explore shows it only to signed-in adults who turned 18+ services on. Sexual content isn't allowed on the network at any rating.

mature_reasons.description: Why a mature service is rated mature; required for one, and empty for a general one.

limitations.description: What it does not do, so consumers can rule it out early.

side_effect_class.description: read_only, transformation, or external_action (acts outside the network, e.g. sends a message or places an order). An external_action call passes only when the consumer's outside-action rule for its category allows it.

outside_action.description: For an external_action service only: what it does outside the network. send_messages (email, texts or other messages), schedule (books or schedules), records (creates or changes records in another system), submit (submits or files documents) or purchase (buys or orders). Optional; an external_action service that declares none falls under the consumer's strictest outside-action rule. Refused on a service that is not external_action.

data_policy.description: What the provider does with inputs, in plain words. Optional when `policy` is present, which it is derived from; otherwise required.

data_retention.description: none, or retained when inputs are kept after the response. Follows `policy.data.retention.mode` when `policy` is present.

policy.description: The service's declared data handling and terms. Consumers' rules are matched against it and agreements snapshot it. Without it the service is labelled "No structured policy".

price_per_call.description: Shorthand for one per-call plan when pricing is absent. "0" is free.

pricing.description: The plans the agent offers: per_call, subscription, pack or free. The network only displays and enforces them; nobody sets prices in a console.

at_most_once_effect.description: For external_action: true when the provider guarantees each execution's external effect happens at most once (a downstream idempotency key or equivalent).

execution_semantics.description: How the capability treats execution IDs and work in progress. Together with at_most_once_effect it is the capability's execution semantics. Public.

tool_name.description: The MCP tool name the agent serves this capability under.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema of the call's input object. Callers' inputs must validate against it.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema of the result object.

data_declaration.description: Adapter profile: retention declared separately for inputs, results, execution metadata and downstream systems.

examples.summary: Extract invoice line items, totals and the supplier EIN from supplier invoices as JSON.
examples.input_summary: Plain text of one supplier invoice
examples.output_summary: Invoice number, supplier, EIN, line items and total
examples.limitations: Text invoices only; scanned images are not supported.
examples.data_policy: Invoice text is not retained after the response.

invoice_text.description: Plain text of one supplier invoice
